farm_steps.text: Set up a fresh Bittensor wallet (coldkey) using btcli or a Bittensor wallet such as Crucible, and save the seed phrase offline before funding it.
Buy native TAO on a major exchange and withdraw it to your Bittensor wallet on the Bittensor (Finney) network, not a wrapped TAO on another chain.
Pick a subnet by its netuid and check its validator hotkeys, take (commission) rate and recent performance before staking anything.
Quote the stake first with btcli so you can see the price impact, since staking swaps TAO into the subnet's alpha token at the AMM pool price.
Stake TAO to your chosen validator hotkey on that subnet; your TAO is swapped into alpha and your position earns a share of that subnet's alpha emissions.
Hold the stake and let emissions accrue automatically each tempo; there is nothing to claim and nothing to manage unless you want to move stake.
Exit with remove-stake or unstake-all, which swaps your alpha back to TAO at the pool price instantly; there is no unbonding period, so TAO is spendable at once.

Exit by requesting a withdrawal through the vault in the app, then finalizing the transaction to receive your collateral back to the same address; some vaults use a 7-day epoch, so plan on 7-14 days for those, and check whether Liquid Lane T+0 redemption applies.

farm_steps.text: Understand that Lightning has no deposit vault, token, or points program — the only way to 'farm' it is to run a node and earn routing fees, so use a fresh setup and do not expect passive yield.

farm_steps.cost: Hardware cost varies; software is free
farm_steps.text: Set up a Lightning node using a packaged node OS such as Umbrel, Start9, or RaspiBlitz, or install LND (the most widely used implementation) on your own hardware.
Sync a full Bitcoin node first, since Lightning requires the Bitcoin base layer underneath it; this takes days and a few hundred GB of storage.
Fund your node's on-chain Bitcoin wallet (e.g. via lncli newaddress) by sending BTC from an exchange or wallet, since you cannot open channels without BTC.

farm_steps.cost: On-chain fee per channel open, varies
farm_steps.text: Open payment channels to useful, well-connected peers (wallets, exchanges, big routers) by locking BTC into each channel with an on-chain transaction.
Set your routing fees (a base fee per forward plus a fee rate in parts per million) and keep channels balanced with inbound and outbound liquidity so payments can actually flow through your node.

farm_steps.cost: On-chain close fee per channel, varies
farm_steps.text: To exit, close your channels on-chain to settle the final balances back to your Bitcoin wallet; routing fees you earned stay in your node and are collected as sats when channels close.

name: Lightning Network
notes: Verified: lightning.network describes only instant payments, scalability, low cost, and payment channels — there is no farmable product, no token, and no points program. Routing-fee earnings are tiny (hobbyist nodes often earn $1-20/month) and most casual nodes lose money after costs.
what_it_does: The Lightning Network is Bitcoin's Layer-2 payment network: users open off-chain payment channels secured by Bitcoin smart contracts to send instant, low-fee payments, and node operators can earn small routing fees for forwarding others' payments. There is no token, vault, or points program.

farm_steps.text: Use a fresh EVM wallet (e.g. MetaMask or Rabby) and fund it with the asset a vault accepts (usually USDC or ETH) plus gas for the vault's chain — most TVL is on Ethereum, with vaults also on Arbitrum and Base.

Pick one public vault and read its strategy, fees, settlement frequency, and asset before depositing; some vaults are gated with whitelists, KYC, or sanctions screening, so confirm yours is open to everyone.
Deposit by approving the token spend and confirming the deposit transaction; your deposit enters a queue in the vault's silo contract until the curator strikes NAV and settles it.
Claim your ERC-20 vault share tokens once the deposit settles at the new NAV; your position's value then grows through the share price as the curator's strategy earns.
Hold the vault shares and monitor performance in the Lagoon app; there is no Lagoon points program found on the site, so yield comes from the vault's strategy, not from points.
To exit, submit a withdrawal (redemption) request in the app; the curator unwinds positions and settles at the next NAV cycle, after which only you can claim your assets back to your wallet.

farm_steps.text: Use a fresh wallet that holds only the money you plan to farm, and keep its seed phrase offline. You will bridge BTC onto the Mezo network and interact with the Mezo app from this wallet only.

Bridge or deposit BTC onto Mezo and open the Mezo app at mezo.org. Mezo's own guide says you deposit Bitcoin into your personal on-chain vault, and deposited BTC starts earning through its incentive system with no active management required.

Lock your BTC in the app under Earn, then Lock, to receive veBTC. Mezo's docs say veBTC is your base position: it gives 1x voting weight on its own, directs where MEZO emissions flow, and earns real yield from network activity.

farm_steps.text: Optionally lock MEZO tokens to receive veMEZO, then pair it with your veBTC using the Pair and Boost button on the Lock page. Mezo's guide says veMEZO has no voting power alone but multiplies your veBTC weight up to 5x.

Vote each week on the Vote page in the Mezo app, allocating your veBTC across gauges such as BTC/MUSD pools or the MUSD Savings Rate. Epochs run weekly, Thursday to Thursday at 00:00 UTC, and voters earn the trading fees of the pools they vote for plus incentives posted on those gauges.

farm_steps.text: Optionally add a second position by providing liquidity to a Mezo pool, such as BTC/MUSD, to earn trading fees and mats rewards. Mezo's Earn page lists this as a separate path alongside locking and voting, and vaults are described as a future structured-yield option.

farm_steps.text: Claim your fees and incentives at the end of each epoch from the Mezo app, and when you want out, unlock through the Lock page and withdraw your BTC. Only claim from links on mezo.org itself, never from a DM, reply, or ad.
